description: Sets the style rules every generation follows, so the game's sounds match (materials, what to avoid, duration, mixing). With game_id it applies to the whole game; with folder_id, to everything inside the folder (added to the game's). Empty text clears it. The text replaces what was there and guides only the next generations: existing sounds stay as they are. Spends no credits. Use it when the user describes the style of the game's audio, before generating; create_game already takes sound_direction for a new game.

folder_id.description: A folder (from list_folders): the rules apply to everything inside it, on top of the game's. Pass game_id OR folder_id.

game_id.description: The game whose rules you set (from list_games). Pass game_id OR folder_id.

text.description: The style rules as plain text (materials, what to avoid, duration, mixing), e.g. 'cartoon, dry, no reverb'. Empty text clears them.

name: set_sound_direction
title: Sound direction
